summary: # Introduction to New Features in Marvelous Designer 2024.2 ## Soft Selection for Dragging Fabric Range In order to better simulate clothing and adjust clothing details, you can select the range of detachment when detaching clothing. ### Activating Soft-Select Detachment To activate the soft-select detachment, please open the simulation and select the move tool. Then, select the soft-select detachment option located in the background right of the 3D window. You can also press **Shift + E** to activate this function. ### Soft-Select Attributes After activating the soft-select detachment function, a spring that is used to set attributes will pop up. The settings in this spring are divided into two parts: - **Detachment Range Settings:** Here, you can set the soft-select detachment type, range, and detachment degree. - **Measurement Method Settings:** In the following options, you can set the measurement method of the soft-select range, whether it shows the range brush, whether it is used only in the selected version, and whether it shows the weight. ### Visual Indicators The range brush is randomly opened. When you move the mouse, you will see two circles that indicate the soft-select: - The **outer circle** indicates the range of soft selection. - The **inner circle** indicates the degree of detachment. ### Full Weight Display Now we turn on the full weight display. When you enable this feature, the soft-select part will show in green. ### Types of Soft-Select The soft-select type is divided into two types: the curve and the straight line. The function curve at the bottom indicates the strength of the soft-select, with the degree of detachment changing from the center of the brush. In different soft-select types, the soft-select curve varies. Additionally, the curve is also affected by the degree of detachment. ### Setting Soft-Select Range Now let's set the soft-select range and the degree of detachment to the highest to observe the differences between the two soft-select types: - When we set it to the **straight line type**, the soft-select center range is very small. - When we set it to the **curve type**, the soft-select center range is wider. ### Resetting Values Return all values to default settings. ### Measurement Methods There are two ways to measure the range: **surface measurement** and **straight line measurement**. - When the measurement is set to **surface**, the soft-select will be applied to the surface of the version you click with the brush. Therefore, your choice will only affect the selected version. - Press and hold the **Shift** key to turn off the Kunden mode. If the method of measuring the range is set to **straight line**, the soft-selection will be applied to all 3D space, such as the back of the mouse. ### Effective Selection Options Press and hold the **Shift** key to turn off the button. This measurement method is more suitable for soft selection of multi-layered clothing. By clicking on the button that only works for selected panels, your soft selection will only work for those selected panels, unaffected by the range measurement method of selection. This option is very effective for panels that are glued together after some simulation. ### Conclusion Thank you for watching! See you in the next video.
